title: Over-the-Air Semantic Alignment via Dual Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.19515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic communications enable task-oriented information exchange, but suffer from latent-space mismatch when transmitter and receiver employ heterogeneous machine learning models. Existing semantic alignment methods rely on digital processing, introducing computational and latency overhead. This paper proposes a dual stacked intelligent metasurfaces (dual-SIM) architecture that performs semantic alignment entirely in the wave domain. By jointly exploiting programmable metasurfaces at both ends of a link and the wireless channel, the proposed architecture realizes an end-to-end linear transformation between heterogeneous latent spaces. We show phase-only multilayer SIM can approximate both supervised linear aligners and zero-shot Parseval-frame equalizers. translated_title: 基于双堆叠智能超表面的空口语义对齐
translated_abstract: 语义通信能够实现面向任务的信息交换，但当发送端和接收端采用异构机器学习模型时，会面临潜在空间不匹配的问题。现有的语义对齐方法依赖数字处理，会引入计算开销和时延开销。本文提出了一种双堆叠智能超表面架构，可在波域中完全实现语义对齐。通过联合利用链路两端的可编程超表面以及无线信道，所提出的架构实现了异构潜在空间之间的端到端线性变换。我们证明了仅相位调控的多层SIM能够同时逼近监督式线性对齐器和零样本Parseval框架均衡器。我们研究了单SIM、非对称与对称的分离式双SIM以及联合优化的双SIM等多种配置，并考虑了信道均衡与建设性信道利用。
tldr: 本文提出双堆叠智能超表面架构，通过在波域中联合利用链路两端的可编程超表面与无线信道，无需数字处理即可实现异构潜在空间之间的端到端语义对齐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dual stacked intelligent metasurfaces (dual-SIM) architecture that achieves end-to-end semantic alignment between heterogeneous latent spaces entirely in the wave domain by jointly exploiting programmable metasurfaces at both link ends and the wireless channel, eliminating digital processing overhead.
